experiences.position: Sponsorship Consultant ICT4D Conference, led by Catholic Relief Services & Partner Consortium,Zambia
experiences.description:
Led 2018 Sponsorship campaign with CRS’s conference manager and delivering sponsor business for the The ICT4D Conference in 2018 Lusaka, Zambia -the annual conference on Information and Communications Technology for Development (ICT4D) with a consortium of partner organisations.  
Sponsors: SAP, Salesforce, Satellite coms  & many more. 
Please see video highlights: www.ict4dconference.org/ict4d-news/ict4d-video-highlights/
Pre event communication with organising partners and global organising team. 
Attended by 900+ multinational delegates.  Onsite: sponsor account management and liaison operations team, and organising media crew during event. 
The ICT4D Conference is led by Catholic Relief Services and organised in collaboration with a Partner Consortium, including NetHope, World Vision, DIAL, IRC, iMerit, ICRISAT, NRC , CTA, UNCDF, SOS Children’s Villages, UNESCO Royal Holloway & DAI
The ICT4D Conference presents an unique opportunity for senior executives and technical advisors to share their practical experience in applying technology innovations to humanitarian aid and development challenges, as well as to build and maintain partnerships between NGOs, government agencies, foundations, private sector companies, and universities.
The event is typically held in the global south with the 10th ICT4D Conference confirmed for May 8-10 2018 in Lusaka, Zambia. 
http://www.ict4dconference.org/
The Conference was successfully delivered
